lines.en: I beat my wings over the grass tips.
Silk threads brush my antennae.
Dust has settled on my wings.
I circled the lamp once.
Light as a sheet of paper.
I drift across an open clearing.
I fly low. The wind scares me.
At night, only I am moving.
I rest a moment on the bark.
My wings have almost no color.
I flew over your head.
I loop back and fly again.
The moonlight makes my wings shine.
I fan my wings slowly, not to tire.
This night is too quiet.
I skim across the water's surface.
I rest motionless on a leaf.
Wings spread flat to catch the moonlight.
My antennae sway gently.
The wind is just right here.
I draw myself in.
A faint ring of light falls on me.
I don't plan to fly.
A little cold. I rest by the stone.
Whoever comes, it doesn't matter.
I fold my wings.
This wood is just quiet enough.

lines.zh: 我停在树皮上，翅粉落了一层。
lines.en: I rest on the bark, a layer of wing dust settling.
Your breathing is too heavy.
Don't blow your breath at me.

lines.zh: 月光被你挡住了，我看不见。
lines.en: You're blocking the moonlight; I can't see.
I'm only a moth.
You're blocking the moonlight.
I can't make out your shape.
You won't catch me, will you?
My wings are so fragile.
Just stand a little farther.
I'm not a butterfly.
My wing is torn.
Don't swat at me.
I fell into the grass.
It hurts. I can't fly.
A wound this small and I'm done for.
The scales fell off my wings.
I shiver my wings.
You're far too strong.
I want to fly one more time.
Half my antenna is broken.
Is that flower sweet?
I smell nectar.
Cornflowers are the best.
You don't have a flower, do you?
Bring it closer. I can't see.
I don't eat that sort of thing.
Is that a lamp? So bright.
I flew back around it once.
The sweet smell is over there.
Are you giving it to me?
You knocked into me.
A corner of my wing is creased.
I hurried into the air.
Don't swat me. I'll shatter.
Your fingers are far too big.
I escaped through your fingers.
I tipped and landed on the grass.
Touch me and my scales rub off.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀擦到你的指节。
lines.en: My wing grazes your knuckle.
You nearly pinned me.
Another one waits by that lamp.
We circle the lamp together.
Don't reach out. We're busy.
Wing brushed against wing.
Our silk will tangle together.
The night is right, and the wind is light.
The dust on my wings spins into thread.
Don't watch. We'll scatter soon.
We'll circle each other.
This lamp is ours tonight.
I'll carry off this bit of thread.
Is this silk thread?
I tuck it under my wing.
You dropped it? I saw it first.
Too heavy. I can't drag it.
I want to touch all things that shine.
I lift it and let it swing.
This tuft of fur fits neatly under my wings.
This isn't a leaf.

lines.zh: 一根线头，我用前足滚着走。
lines.en: A thread end; I roll it along with my forelegs.
There's a flower over there.
I see a light.
A sweet smell, close now.
I lift off.
What's that swaying?
I fly that way.
I don't want to get near people.
But that light is so bright.
I'll circle once and then go.
My antennae point that way.
I ride the wind over.
That lamp has drawn me in.
I'm getting closer to it.
My wings are tiring.
I'll circle once more.
Don't move. I'm above you.
I can't see the ground clearly.

lines.zh: 有盏灯在那边，我朝它飞。
lines.en: There's a lamp over there; I fly toward it.
I've come back this way.
Missed it. Searching again.
I dust you with wing scales.
I bumped your face once.
I'm too small to knock you off balance.
That one took all my strength.
I landed on your shoulder.
I fan air by your ear.
A wing flicked your eye.
I've drawn back again.
That can't hurt you, can it?
I did my best already.
I come out of the cocoon.
My wings are still wet.
I slowly open them.
This much moonlight is enough.
Silk still clings to me.
I land on the nearest leaf.
Tonight is my first flight.
My eyes are big. Don't be scared.
The wind lifted me.
I arrive without a sound.

lines.zh: 我的翅膜薄，火一舔就焦。
lines.en: My wing membrane is thin; one lick of flame and it singes.
I fell on grass. Soft, thankfully.
Water pinned me down. I can't fly.
The blast threw me far.

lines.zh: 一根细刺穿过我的翅膀。
lines.en: A thin dart pierced my wing.
The spell froze me in place.
No nectar, and I grow lighter and lighter.

lines.zh: 闪电亮得刺眼，我掉了下去。
lines.en: The flash blinded me and I dropped.
No wind to hold me up.
